messages.author: c676d94b8ba27cbe
messages.subject: Legend for semTools' plotProbe chart
parts:
Dear Group, 

Is there a way to control the legend that appears on the interaction chart produced by plotProbe in semTools?  I tried the following, but it added a blank legend with a title in addition to the automatic one. 

plotProbe(result2way, xlim=c(-2,2), xlab="x-axis", ylab="y-axis")
legend("bottomleft", c("min", "-1 std dev","mean","+1 std dev", "max"))

I'd like to get it out of the way and clean it up.  I saw a way to put it outside the chart area on stackoverflow (for a generic chart, that is), but this requires the use of the legend argument above:
legend("topright", inset=c(-0.2,0), legend=c("A","B"), pch=c(1,3), title="Group")

I also tried to use legendMain and legendVal within the plotProbe argument, but received errors stating that each "matched by multiple actual arguments" (in addition to "50 or more warnings", apparently).

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Legend for semTools' plotProbe chart
parts: Is there a way to control the legend that appears on the interaction chart produced by plotProbe in semTools?

I don't think so.  The automated legend is created in a hidden function called by plotProbe.  If you can navigate the code, your best option will probably be to open the source code and fiddle with the hidden function, which you can view in the console this way:

semTools:::plotSingleProbe

That function is defined at the bottom of the file "probeInteraction.R" in the source, available at https://github.com/simsem/semTools in the folder 

https://github.com/simsem/semTools/tree/master/semTools/R

Good luck,

Terry
